text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит runs with everything she
can
muster, but ultimately fails to win
the Japanese
Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Frustrated at letting her dream slip
through her
fingers, she bursts into tears.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Once she calms down, she comes to the
happy
realization that even though she
lost, she still
gave her fans the thrill of
an incredible race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With a smile, she tells me that she'll
show them
another amazing race at the
Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
